title: 神宮女子の観戦Vlog！推し活まるっと1日密着
scene: 神宮球場の正面ゲートで待ち合わせ、チケット片手にワクワク入場。売店で球場グルメやドリンクを買って、観客席で乾杯＆自撮り。試合開始！友達同士で応援グッズ振って盛り上がる姿。
caption: 今日は神宮球場で女子だけの推し活観戦Vlogを撮ってみたよ⚾️💕『野球好きなんだけど、一緒に行く友達なかなかいないんだよね…』って思ってたけど、Draftで観戦仲間ができて初めてのグループ観戦！ゲート前で待ち合わせして、ワクワクしながらスタンドへ。売店では球場グルメも迷いがち🤣そして乾杯でテンション爆上がり🍻推し選手のグッズを手に応援しながら、やっぱり現地最高ってなっちゃう。推し活友達がいると、写真もいっぱい撮れてSNS映え間違いなし！『野球詳しくないんだけど大丈夫？』って人も、雰囲気で楽しめちゃうから心配いらないよ。一緒に盛り上がれる観戦仲間、Draftで見つけてみて！あなたはどれに共感しましたか？

prompts.kling: A lively day at Meiji Jingu Stadium: Three Japanese women in their 20s meet at the entrance, laughing as they show their tickets. The camera follows them hand-held as they walk through the bustling concourse, stopping at a food stall to buy signature stadium eats and drinks, then move to their seats. The friends take cheerful selfies, raise their drinks for a toast, and energetically cheer with team towels and goods as the game begins. Natural lighting, casual summer outfits, upbeat, no AI artifacts, authentic smartphone-shot look, hand-held movement throughout.
prompts.veo: vertical, 9:16, 10-15s, photorealistic, smartphone-shot style. 0-5s: Three Japanese women in their 20s excitedly meet and enter Meiji Jingu Stadium, tickets in hand, capturing the energetic entrance and moving through the concourse with crowds in the background. 5-10s: The group stops at a lively food stall, laughing and buying classic stadium food and drinks. 10-15s: They sit in the stands, take selfies, clink drinks for a toast, and wave team towels and goods, supporting their favorite players. No overlays, just natural, joyful moments.
